# I-23 additive pulses. Do not edit I-16 / I-16B / I-18 / I-21 / I-22 on_actions.
# TUR yearly pulse is autumn, not 1 January. Opening beats (.1/.2) and the 1838
# French-pressure beat (.3) are monthly with staggered floors so they do not
# land on the same day as each other or I-16 Baltalimanı.

on_yearly_pulse_country = {
	on_actions = {
		sp_i23_yearly_events
	}
}

on_monthly_pulse_country = {
	on_actions = {
		sp_i23_monthly_events
	}
}

sp_i23_yearly_events = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:TUR ?= this
				game_date >= 1843.1.1
				NOT = { has_variable = sp_i23_pulse_closed }
			}
			set_variable = sp_i23_pulse_closed
		}
	}
	events = {
		sp_i23.4
	}
}

sp_i23_monthly_events = {
	events = {
		sp_i23.1
		sp_i23.2
		sp_i23.3
	}
}
